LanguageData.Niceties_Settings_Intro: Each nicety is optional. Off means vanilla for that one rule. Combat, fire, and outdoor rot are never blocked.
LanguageData.Niceties_Settings_PresetsTip: Presets only change the knobs under each nicety. Which niceties are on stays as you set it.
LanguageData.Niceties_Settings_SnapshotDiffers: This save still uses older baked settings than the options below.
LanguageData.Niceties_Settings_SnapshotHost: Multiplayer: this save runs on the host's baked settings. Your changes here apply to single-player games.
LanguageData.Niceties_Settings_ApparelCareTip: Worn clothes skip or scale the daily deterioration tick. Combat and fire still damage hit points. Clothes left on the ground still rot outdoors.
LanguageData.Niceties_Settings_QualityScaleTip: Off: no daily wear while worn (Soft). On: awful/poor wear like vanilla; good and excellent wear less; masterwork and legendary skip daily wear.
LanguageData.Niceties_Settings_CraftingBonusTip: A pawn's Crafting skill reduces remaining daily wear, up to half at level 20.
LanguageData.Niceties_Settings_CorpseApparel: Keep the same rule on corpses
LanguageData.Niceties_Settings_CorpseApparelTip: Off: apparel on a dead pawn deteriorates as vanilla. On: the worn-care rule still applies.
LanguageData.Niceties_Settings_ThroneAltarTip: Royalty throne-room requirements ignore "no altars". A throne in the room keeps it a throne room instead of a temple. Needs Royalty + Ideology to matter.
LanguageData.Niceties_Settings_WearAnyTip: Colonists may wear any gendered cut (royal vest/corset, hats, and mod apparel that uses the same tag) without the wrong-gender thought. Pawns the game generates (raiders, traders, new joiners) still dress as vanilla.
LanguageData.Niceties_Settings_WearAnyGenerated: Also let generated pawns wear any cut
LanguageData.Niceties_Settings_WearAnyGeneratedTip: Raiders, traders and other generated pawns may also be dressed in any gendered cut, like Niceties 1.x did. Off by default.
LanguageData.Niceties_Settings_HideCrypto: Hide cryptosleep pawns from the bar
LanguageData.Niceties_Settings_HideCryptoTip: Colonists already in a cryptosleep casket are omitted from the colonist bar. They stay visible while being carried to a casket.
LanguageData.Niceties_Settings_CryptoCountTip: A small "+N in cryptosleep" note next to the colonist bar, so you know why it looks short.
LanguageData.Niceties_Settings_MeleeHuntTip: Hunters may hunt with a melee weapon. Ranged hunting is unchanged.
LanguageData.Niceties_Settings_UnarmedHuntTip: Hunters with no weapon may still hunt (fists). Off by default — easy to get someone killed.
LanguageData.Niceties_Settings_SharedRoomsTip: A gizmo on a bed marks the room as shared. It stays a bedroom instead of flipping to barracks, so roommates (and royalty) are not punished for living together.
LanguageData.Niceties_Settings_SkipDisturbedSleepTip: Only a roommate who owns a bed in the same room is ignored for disturbed sleep. Visitors and other colonists still wake the sleeper. Outdoor sleep uses normal vanilla disturbance.
LanguageData.Niceties_ShareRoomTip: Mark this bedroom as shared. Extra beds stay a bedroom instead of a barracks. Roommates skip the sharing-a-room mood hit.
LanguageData.Niceties_Settings_LeaveAWayOutTip: Pawns skip finishing a wall that would trap someone or block leftover frames. They step aside before closing themselves in. Replace Stuff frames count; in-place wood-to-stone wall swaps stay solid so a freezer can still be replaced from inside. Right-click force construct still builds it. Inspired by Smarter Construction — original code, not a port.
LanguageData.Niceties_OpenBuilds_WouldEnclose: Finishing this would wall someone in.
LanguageData.Niceties_OpenBuilds_WouldTrapSelf: Finishing this would trap the builder with no way out.
LanguageData.Niceties_Hunt_TooBig: {0} is too large for melee hunting.
LanguageData.Niceties_CryptoHiddenCountTip: Colonists hidden from the bar by Niceties: cryptosleep, plus growth vats and pods if you ticked them. Turn this off in Mod Options.
LanguageData.Niceties_Hunt_TooDangerous: {0} is too likely to turn on a melee hunter.
LanguageData.Niceties_Hunt_TooBigInspect: Melee hunters skip this animal: it is over the melee hunting size cap.
LanguageData.Niceties_Hunt_TooDangerousInspect: Melee hunters skip this animal: it is too likely to turn on them.
LanguageData.Niceties_CryptoRosterTip: Click to list them and jump to one.
LanguageData.Niceties_Settings_CryptoRoster: Click the note to list them
LanguageData.Niceties_Settings_CryptoRosterTip: Clicking the note opens a list of the hidden colonists. Pick one to jump to their casket. Only on this computer.
LanguageData.Niceties_Settings_HideVats: Also hide children in growth vats
LanguageData.Niceties_Settings_HideVatsTip: Biotech growth-vat children drop off the colonist bar too. Only on this computer.
LanguageData.Niceties_Settings_HidePods: Also hide pawns in biosculpter pods and subcore scanners
LanguageData.Niceties_Settings_HidePodsTip: Colonists inside a biosculpter pod or subcore scanner drop off the colonist bar too. Only on this computer.
LanguageData.Niceties_Settings_NobleAlert: Warn when a noble is in a shared room
LanguageData.Niceties_Settings_NobleAlertTip: An alert names titled colonists whose bed is in a room marked shared, since their title wants a bedroom of their own.
LanguageData.Niceties_NobleSharedRoomDesc: {0} own a bed in a room marked shared. Their royal title wants a bedroom of their own, so a shared room does not count. Untick Share room, or give them their own bedroom.
LanguageData.Niceties_Settings_EncloseOverlay: Outline the area a selected wall frame would close off
LanguageData.Niceties_Settings_EncloseOverlayTip: With one wall frame selected, the cells finishing it would wall in are outlined in orange.
LanguageData.Niceties_Settings_MaxRoom: Largest area that counts as walled in: {0} cells
LanguageData.Niceties_Settings_MaxRoomTip: An area beside a new wall with fewer walkable cells than this counts as closed. 80 by default, so a 9×9 room counts as open. Bigger values catch bigger rooms but cost more.
LanguageData.Niceties_Settings_Revenge: Skip animals that turn on hunters more often than: {0}
LanguageData.Niceties_Settings_RevengeTip: Melee hunters skip animals whose chance to turn manhunter when hurt is above this. A hunt-designated animal they skip says so in its inspect pane.
LanguageData.Niceties_Settings_ResetOneTip: Reset {0} to its defaults. Other niceties are untouched.
LanguageData.Niceties_Status_NeedsRoyaltyIdeology: Inactive: needs both Royalty and Ideology.
LanguageData.Niceties_Status_SmarterConstruction: Inactive: Smarter Construction is loaded and does this job.
LanguageData.Niceties_Status_Unavailable: Unavailable on this RimWorld build. See Player.log.
LanguageData.Niceties_Status_RoommateSleepUnavailable: Roommate sleep part unavailable on this RimWorld build. See Player.log.
LanguageData.Niceties_Status_HostBaked: Multiplayer: this game uses the host's setting.
